substrate_width.source: Compatibility field means only the rectangular y width; actual substrate uses explicit x/y bounds below

bar_length.source: Declared independent control for free hot-bar length; not a modification of the saved continuation.

bore_width.source: Inherited stress-free nominal 2 micrometre clearance per side; not calibrated from video

geometry.source: Complete positive-x 3 mm pass plus 2.7 mm shoulder radius and 2h=1.3 mm support buffer; no paper-size reproduction

phases.name: hot_rotation_and_feed_entry
phases.source: Already-hot model starts rotation and axial feeding together; 20 ms is an engineering setting, not a measured heating time

phases.name: stationary_feed_attempt
phases.source: Paper PDF p7 motivates filling before traverse; this 0.2 s stationary feeding attempt does not assert that spreading has occurred

phases.name: traverse_entry
phases.source: Paper PDF p4 nominal speeds; 20 ms transition is assumed and contributes 0.0212 mm travel

phases.name: diagnostic_unused_track_to_1mm
phases.source: Unused common tail for finite-inventory planning of both controls; all comparison solves must remain in stationary feeding before 0.220 s.

process_intent.required_observation: Initially eligible supplied material must cross the bore and plastically spread under the annular shoulder before the supervisor advances to traverse
process_intent.insufficient_spreading_action: STOP_AND_REPORT_NOT_FILLED; do not prescribe material motion or silently extend the registered fill duration

limitations: This is an independent hot prebonded initial state, not a continuation or cropping of any old deformed checkpoint
Bar width 2.5 mm, shoulder diameter 5.4 mm and layer height 1.5 mm are inherited reduced geometry without geometric similarity to the paper
Command integrals and volume estimates do not prove passage, radial flow, deposition, convergence or metallurgical bonding
The rectangular kernel buffer is a finite-domain planning allowance, not a spatial convergence certificate
No continuous replenishment, cold-start heating, plunge or lift is introduced
Inherited quasi-static, FKS, thermal and visible-neighbour event limitations remain; unchanged force, energy and geometry gates still apply
The bar remains deformable above the 2.5 mm tool top; only the top 0.5 mm cap z is prescribed.

diagnostic_control.changed_factor: bar_length and resulting position of the same 0.5 mm material actuator cap
limitations: Not a proposed calibrated production geometry or a representation of cold feed/support.
Existing simulation state must not be cropped or relabelled as either control.
A response difference would be sensitivity evidence, not proof that the shorter bar is correct.
